evidence.observation: Pressure steady at ~3.02-3.04 Torr through the ramp and early growth
Pressure rose steadily from 3.15 Torr (2760 s) to 3.48 Torr (3240 s), about 15% above baseline
Ar flow held at ~100 sccm, on setpoint, so the rise is not caused by more gas coming in
Temperature holding at 750 °C with stable heater power, so the thermal side looks normal
Exhaust O2 sensor not installed, so the atmosphere can't be verified during growth as required

args.missing_evidence: Something that tells an exhaust or pump restriction apart from air leaking into the tube. Options: exhaust O2 readings, a leak or rate-of-rise check with the inlet closed, or a look at the exhaust line, valve and pump.
